fire: Thousands marched in Tehran to hear supreme leader Ali Khamenei speak on Friday.

Analysts in Seoul say North Korean leader Kim Jong Un fears a coup.

quiet: Thousands marched in Leeds to hear union leader Sarah Brown speak on Friday.

Followers of the local vicar Tom Harris gathered outside the church.

short: title before a foreign strongman's name
notes: Card: cleric, leader, President, 'such as' before Gulf clerics, 'under' Pol Pot.
